guides.definition: Registers a Workbox runtime route with a named caching strategy. Browser/build-tool content: configure Workbox in a service worker or build pipeline and serve over a secure context; the Web APIs surface is editor-only.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Imported strategy class such as CacheFirst or NetworkFirst.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Fetch request destination matched by the route.

examples.title: Cache images on demand
examples.explanation: CacheFirst is appropriate for versioned or slow-changing assets; pair runtime caches with expiration policies in production.

guides.definition: Routes the Workbox-generated precache manifest from an injected service worker. Browser/build-tool content: configure Workbox in a service worker or build pipeline and serve over a secure context; the Web APIs surface is editor-only.

examples.title: Use an injected precache manifest
examples.explanation: injectManifest replaces __WB_MANIFEST during the build; do not hand-edit the generated revision list.

guides.definition: Uses workbox-window to register a service worker and observe an installed update. Browser/build-tool content: configure Workbox in a service worker or build pipeline and serve over a secure context; the Web APIs surface is editor-only.

parameters.name: serviceWorkerUrl
parameters.description: URL of the built service worker.

parameters.name: waitingHandler
parameters.description: Action performed when an update waits for activation.

examples.title: Notify when an update is waiting
examples.explanation: The waiting event lets the application choose a user-friendly update policy instead of unexpectedly replacing an active page's service worker.
